collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — TINY ISLAND MOMENTS, T126 to T175 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more tiny moments continuing T001-T125 (your 500 Tiny Island Moments, played as 125 openings with 4 endings each).
collection.description: A rainbow appears over the hill after a brief shower.

e1.name: Ending 1
e1.text: A rainbow appears over the hill after a brief shower. Children run toward it, hoping to reach the end.

e2.name: Ending 2
e2.text: A rainbow appears over the hill after a brief shower. (name1) counts the colors and gets a different number each time.

e3.name: Ending 3
e3.text: A rainbow appears over the hill after a brief shower. A second, fainter rainbow appears above the first, and the village gasps.

e4.name: Ending 4
e4.text: A rainbow appears over the hill after a brief shower. It fades slowly, and everyone returns to work in a brighter mood.
